canonical_name: Free Mary Magdalene Meditation Circle (The Soul Institute / Adora Winquist)
summary: A free virtual monthly meditation webinar hosted solo by Adora Winquist of The Soul Institute, cross-posted to Eventbrite under near-identical city-tagged listings (AVL, New York, St. Louis, and many other cities) for local SEO/ad targeting. All three listings share the exact same location field 'Virtual, Asheville, NC' and the identical first-person-singular description ('I invite you to meditate with me...'), indicating one host running one recurring session, not distinct local communities. It functions as a lead-generation funnel into Adora's paid retreats and membership, not a returning-member circle.

evidence.note: All three 'city' variants (AVL, New York, St. Louis) list the identical location 'Virtual, Asheville, NC' and word-for-word identical first-person description 'I invite you to meditate with me...', showing one host running one session under multiple city-targeted slugs.

No membership language anywhere in the descriptions or tags — no 'our group', 'members', dues, or named regulars; tags are generic wellness/marketing terms (Healing Focus, Self Mastery, Personal Transformation).
The Soul Institute is Adora Winquist's personal wisdom-school brand (Asheville-based); she runs paid retreats, a 'Pathway Membership', and products, with the free circle as an entry funnel.

site:eventbrite.com search shows the same 'Free Mary Magdalene Meditation Circle' listing replicated for many other cities (LA, Nashville, Miami, San Diego, Charleston, Boston, San Francisco), all the same 1st-Tuesday 7-7:40pm EST session, confirming a city-tagged ad-targeting pattern rather than distinct communities.

A Meetup group under The Soul Institute's name was found referenced but its page now 404s, suggesting any attempt at a persistent membership platform was abandoned; social presence (Instagram @adorawinquist, Facebook) is tied to Adora personally, not a 'Mary Magdalene Circle' community page.
